commentary.bulkers: Onn Shipping have committed their Capesize "Bulk Providence" 180/2011 Stx, Korea (SS/DD 11/2026) to Chinese interests at USD 28 mill, while the two-years-older "Braverus" 170/2009 Sungdong, Korea (SS 09/2028, DD 09/2026) from Enterprises Shipping & Trading was committed at USD 22 mill. Remind you that the "Blue Lhotse" 180/2011 Daehan, Korea (SS/DD 03/2026) was sold back in December at USD 28,8 mill. Following the acquisition of the Kamsarmax "Patra" 80/2012 Universal, Japan (SS/DD 10/2025) in February at USD 15,75 mill, clients of Brave Maritime have now purchased the "Energy Hope" 82/2012 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS/DD 02/2027) from Usui Kaiun at USD 17 mill. On the Supramax sector, CTM SAM committed their "CS Sonoma" 56/2010 Jiangsu, China (SS 02/2030, DD 03/2026, Scrubber fitted) to Far Eastern interests at USD 11,3 mill. For comparison, the sister vessel "Avra I" 56/2010 Jiangsu, China (SS/DD 05/2025) was sold earlier this month at low USD 11 mill. Furthermore, Starbulk committed the "Strange Attractor" 55/2006 Mitsui, Japan (SS 10/2026, DD 07/2025, Scrubber fitted) at mid USD 9 mill. For reference, the one-year-younger sister vessel "Orion" 56/2007 Mitsui, Japan (SS 05/2027, DD 08/2025) was committed a couple of months ago at USD 10,6 mill. POLSTEAM have committed their Handysize "Warmia" 39/2005 Tianjin, China (SS/DD 10/2025, Ice Class 1C) at USD 6,3 mill, while the sister vessel "Mazury" 39/2005 Tianjin, China (SS/DD 04/2025) was sold a month ago at region USD 6 mill. Moreover, the "Tate J" 34/2012 Spp, Korea (SS 01/2027, DD 06/2025) was committed at high USD 13 mill. Remind you that the two- years-older sister vessel "Four Nabucco" 34/2010 Spp, Korea (SS/DD 05/2025) was sold back in December at USD 11,8 mill.
commentary.tankers: DH Holdings have committed their VLCC "DHT Lotus" 320/2011 Bohai, China (SS/DD 01/2026, Scrubber fitted) to Chinese interests at USD 55 mill, while the two-years-older "Yinghao Spirit" 296/2009 Bohai, China (SS 02/2029, DD 09/2026) was committed to Chinese interests also at region USD 52 mill. Note that the "Yinghao Spirit" (ex "Advantage Virtue") was sold to current sellers back in September at USD 51 mill. The MR2 "Centennial Matsuyama" 47/2008 Onomichi, Japan (SS 11/2028, DD 11/2026) was committed to undisclosed interests at high USD 16 mill. For reference, the one-year-older sister vessel "Fos Power" 47/2007 Onomichi, Japan (SS 04/2027, DD 12/2025) was sold back in September at USD 24 mill.

freight.Capesize: Iron ore rates on the West Australia / China route continued throughout round trips on the same route were reported around usd 22,000/23,000 pd levels. No period activity to report here.
freight.Kamsarmax / Panamax: North Pacific rounds ranged at the usd 13,000/15,000 pd. A number of Indonesian and Australian trips into China were reported at the level of usd 11,000/15,000 pd. Australian trips into India were fixed around usd 15,000/17,000 pd. South East Asian trips via South America into China were reported at the level of usd 10,000/12,000 pd. Indian trips via South America into China were fixed around usd 11,000/13,000 pd. Continental trips via US East Coast or South America into China were reported at the level of usd 18,000/20,000 pd. South American trips into China were fixed around usd 14,000/16,000 pd plus ballast bonus at the usd 400K/600K. On the period front, a Kamsarmax was reported fixed in the usd 14,250 pd for 5/8 months employment basis delivery China.
freight.Ultramax / Supramax: A number of Indonesian trips into China were reported fixed at the level of usd 13,000/15,000 pd. Indonesian trips into India were fixed around usd 16,000/18,000 pd. Indian trips into China were reported at the level of usd 12,000/13,000 pd. South African trips into India were fixed around usd 13,500/14,500 pd plus ballast bonus at the usd 135K/145K. No period activity to report here.
freight.Handymax / Handysize: A number of Indonesian and Australian trips into China were reported at the level of usd 10,000/11,000 pd. West African trips into South America were fixed around usd 6,000/7,000 pd. Continental trips into Mediterranean via Baltic were reported at the level of usd 14,000/16,000 pd. Mediterranean trips into Continent or South America were fixed around usd 6,000/7,000 pd. South American Coastal trips were reported at the level of usd 14,000/16,000 pd. South American trips into West Africa were fixed around usd 12,000/13,000 pd. No period activity to report here.
